messages:
Priya (Sales SE): Hey team — need to onboard ACME's 2-week trial. They want: hosted API keys + ephemeral keys for app testing, one small dedicated pool (2xA10G) for a 72h performance test, and a Private VPC peering for security review. Can we sketch the billing project + spend cap flow?
Amy (Account Exec): Thanks — ACME expects a single billing org for the POC, with spend cap and free credits applied. Also asked about whether using Dedicated consumes credits or billed separate.
Mateo (Infra Eng): Dedicated pools are billed to the billing project but we can tag usage so finance separates commit vs metered. For a 72h reserved test we can do a short-term reservation. Need start/end times and a quota bump for GPUs.
Priya (Sales SE): Start: 2026-05-12 09:00 PT, end: 2026-05-15 09:00 PT. Quota target: 2 GPUs, sustained 100% utilization. Spend cap requested: $5,000 limit for the org during the trial.
Sanjay (Security): For VPC peering we need their CIDR, allowed subnets, and whether they require ingress IP allowlist. Also KMS integration question — will keys stay in their KMS?
Amy (Account Exec): They want customer-managed KMS for model encryption and SOC2 attestation. Also asking if SSO/SCIM for console access is possible for trial users.
Mateo (Infra Eng): KMS: for Private we can support their KMS; for hosted trial we can either use Redwood-managed KMS or set up a customer-managed KMS with extra onboarding. SSO/SCIM for a short trial is manual invite usually, unless they want a SCIM connector set up.
Priya (Sales SE): Can billing project be created now so we can provision keys and issue ephemeral API keys to devs? Also need the spend-cap enforcement to prevent overruns.
BillingBot: Created provisional billing project "acme-trial-1845234". Applied trial_credits: 5000 USD and spend_cap: 5000 USD. Note: spend_cap blocks provisioning of additional dedicated reservations without approval.
Priya (Sales SE): Great — do we need approvals to allocate the 2xA10G short reservation against the spend cap?
Mateo (Infra Eng): Yes — infra-owner approval needed to deduct from spend_cap for dedicated capacity. Ping @InfraOncall for manual approval.
Priya (Sales SE): @InfraOncall can you approve a 72h reservation for 2xA10G starting 2026-05-12 09:00 PT? Estimated consumption: ~$2,700 incl tax.
InfraOncallBot: Reservation request logged: res-req-8812. Requires manual confirm by infra engineer.
Mateo (Infra Eng): Approved — res-req-8812 accepted. Reserving pool now. ETA 20m to be runnable.
Sanjay (Security): Quick note: to proceed with VPC peering we need their peering CIDR and a signed NDA (they requested extra controls). Also confirm if we should enable IP allowlist for API keys.
Amy (Account Exec): ACME legal said NDA signed today. I'll upload to the ticket. They want IP allowlist + short-lived ephemeral keys for devs.
Priya (Sales SE): For ephemeral keys — can we issue 24h keys via the console? If not, we can use the Keys API to mint tokens. Example curl below: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/keys/mint -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"project":"acme-trial-1845234","ttl":"24h","scopes":["generation","embeddings"]}'```
Mateo (Infra Eng): That endpoint exists for internal flows, will enable for sales SE role for this org. We'll rotate the admin token after.
BillingBot: Note: applying trial credits reduces available spend_cap reporting but does not auto-release credits for dedicated reservations. Manual reconcile after POC.
Amy (Account Exec): ACME asked whether Dedicated billing shows up on monthly invoice or via separate reserved contract. Answer: it will appear under the billing project as usage lines; reserved discounts applied when reservation completes.
Priya (Sales SE): Any security blockers left?
Sanjay (Security): If they want customer KMS + VPC peering + IP allowlist we can do it for Private deployment. For hosted/dedicated trial we'll offer managed KMS but can customer-manage for an extra onboarding step — need their KMS ARN and KMS admin contact. Also need to run a short security questionnaire (5 Qs) and documented data flows.
Priya (Sales SE): I'll send the 5-question security checklist and request KMS ARN. Also looping in their infra contact for CIDR.
Mateo (Infra Eng): Pool is up. Endpoint: https://dedicated-us-west2.redwood.com/pools/res-8812. Devs can hit it once keys are minted.
Priya (Sales SE): Perfect. Final checklist for handoff: 1) Billing project confirmed (acme-trial-1845234) 2) Trial credits $5k applied + spend cap set 3) Reservation approved and pool live 4) Ephemeral keys endpoint enabled 5) Security: NDA uploaded + KMS ARN pending + CIDR pending.
Amy (Account Exec): I'll own KMS and legal follow-ups. Priya — please send the security checklist and mint the first two ephemeral keys for dev leads.
Priya (Sales SE): On it. Will post keys in 1:1 after rotation. :lock_with_key:
InfraOncallBot: Deployment and billing artifacts recorded in ticket #T-5421.
Mateo (Infra Eng): FYI — if we hit unexpected spend, billing alerts will fire to finance and the project will be paused at the spend_cap. Keep an eye on token usage for generation-heavy tests.
Priya (Sales SE): Thanks everyone, closing this thread — follow-ups in ticket #T-5421 and ACME Slack channel.
Amy (Account Exec): :thumbsup:
